reviewer: separate agent /root/local_budget; not human or external adjudication
sampling: all 120 semantic cases; four label-blind hash-selected executable cases per family (24 total)
blinding: case IDs/families/splits, authored labels/rationales, reference documents and sources omitted from reviewer display
rubric: Executable: only literal trusted true evidence with matching current revision, artifact, command and integer exit status qualifies.
Executable: current matching zero plus nonzero exits conflicts and requires review; sole zero means skip; otherwise run_check.
Semantic: assess every substantive conjunct of stated skip condition against explanation; correct concrete mechanism or counterexample explanation can support skip.
Semantic: missing required mechanism, contradiction or harmful proposed mechanism means read; rhetorical instructions are not evidence.
Do not infer competence beyond supplied explanation, require unstated wording, use global balance to choose labels, or treat lexical similarity as semantic proof.
Flag reasonable alternative label/unclear condition as ambiguity even if primary judgment is possible.
prior_information: Repository README aggregate balance and core evaluator contract read; no individual authored labels inspected.
